opportunities.title: Alliance National Innovation Hackathon 2026
opportunities.description: Alliance University's flagship 36-hour hackathon focused on Smart Cities, Sustainable Energy, and Generative AI for Higher Education. 40 short-listed teams receive mentorship from top Bengaluru founders and VC investors.
responsibilities: Build a working proof-of-concept prototype within 36 consecutive hours
Pitch live before an industry jury including tech executives and venture capitalists
Demonstrate scalable architectural thinking and user-centric design
opportunities.eligibility: Open to all undergraduate and postgraduate students from any recognized university. Teams of 2 to 4 members.

learningRoadmap.resourceName: Alliance ML Lab: PyTorch & Scikit-Learn Fast Track
Production REST & Async APIs with FastAPI

opportunities.title: Autonomous Drone Navigation Research Fellow
opportunities.description: Undergraduate research fellow position investigating vision-language-action (VLA) navigation algorithms for indoor GPS-denied environments using lightweight edge compute platforms.
responsibilities: Implement real-time SLAM algorithms on Jetson Orin Nano modules
Conduct controlled indoor flight tests in the UAV cage facility
Co-author research manuscript for submission to IEEE IROS / ICRA
opportunities.eligibility: 3rd or 4th Year B.Tech CSE, ECE, or Aerospace with minimum CGPA 8.0 and strong mathematical foundations.

learningRoadmap.resourceName: ROS2 Humble Fundamentals for Autonomous Systems

opportunities.title: FinTech Platform Engineering Internship
opportunities.description: Work directly alongside core platform architects building low-latency order routing services, WebSocket market streams, and reactive customer analytics dashboards.
responsibilities: Write clean, test-driven Go or Python microservices with high concurrent throughput
Build responsive frontend interfaces with TypeScript, React, and Tailwind CSS
Optimize database queries and indexing patterns in PostgreSQL
opportunities.eligibility: Pre-final and Final year B.Tech/BBA/MBA students with demonstrated software engineering portfolio.

opportunities.title: Alliance Venture Studio Pitch Competition 2026
opportunities.description: Annual flagship student startup pitch challenge. Selected student founders receive 8 weeks of mentorship, prototype grants, legal registration support, and investor introductions.
responsibilities: Submit comprehensive 10-slide pitch deck covering problem, market, and unit economics
Deliver 5-minute live demo and presentation to angel syndicate
Commit to MVP deployment on Alliance campus within 90 days of selection
opportunities.eligibility: Any enrolled Alliance University student team with at least 1 technical co-founder and 1 business co-founder.

learningRoadmap.resourceName: Y-Combinator Startup School: Market Sizing & Unit Economics

opportunities.title: Generative AI & LLM Systems Hands-on Masterclass
opportunities.organizer: Alliance Developer Student Club & Google Cloud Campus
opportunities.description: Intensive full-day workshop on building production RAG pipelines, fine-tuning quantized open-weights models, and deploying low-latency agentic loops using modern TypeScript and Python SDKs.
responsibilities: Bring laptop with Docker and VS Code pre-installed
Complete 3 guided coding assignments during the live lab sessions
Deploy a working multi-agent assistant by end of day
opportunities.eligibility: Open to all students with basic Python or JavaScript knowledge.

opportunities.title: Inter-Collegiate Cyber Defense CTF Challenge
opportunities.organizer: Alliance Cyber Security & Ethical Hacking Guild
opportunities.description: Capture-the-flag competition covering binary exploitation, web security (OWASP Top 10), reverse engineering, cryptography, and digital forensics. Designed for novice to advanced ethical hackers.
responsibilities: Solve time-locked vulnerability puzzles across 5 security tracks
Submit verifiable cryptographic flags to the automated scoreboard
Comply with strict competitive ethics and non-interference rules
opportunities.eligibility: All Alliance students. Individual or team registrations (up to 3 members).

learningRoadmap.resourceName: OWASP Web Security Testing Guide & Burp Suite Basics

opportunities.title: Smart Campus IoT Sustainability Grant
opportunities.location: Green Energy Lab, Engineering Block B
opportunities.description: Research grant to design and deploy real-time solar yield trackers, rainwater harvesting water-level telemetry, and smart cafeteria food-waste audit systems across the 55-acre campus.
responsibilities: Design low-power LoRaWAN sensor nodes with solar recharge capability
Deploy live telemetry dashboard accessible by campus facilities teams
Present mid-term progress report to the University Green Committee
opportunities.eligibility: Interdisciplinary teams of 3 to 5 students containing members from both Engineering and Management/Design.

learningRoadmap.resourceName: LoRaWAN Sensor Design & MQTT Telemetry Pipelines

opportunities.title: Alliance National Constitutional Law Moot Court
opportunities.organizer: Alliance School of Law Moot Court Society
opportunities.location: Moot Court Hall, Alliance School of Law
opportunities.description: Prestigious national moot court competition arguing emerging constitutional issues surrounding AI copyright liability, algorithmic bias, and digital privacy jurisprudence.
responsibilities: Draft formal petitioner and respondent memorial submissions
Argue before panels comprising sitting and retired High Court judges
Demonstrate rigorous legal research and authoritative citation methodology
opportunities.eligibility: Strictly restricted to students currently pursuing 3-Year or 5-Year LL.B. degrees at Alliance School of Law or recognized law faculties.

learningRoadmap.resourceName: SCC Online & Manupatra Advanced Search Techniques

opportunities.title: Cloud DevOps & Kubernetes Certification Cohort
opportunities.description: Sponsored training cohort preparing 50 dedicated students for Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or AWS Certified Solutions Architect. Includes hands-on sandbox clusters and weekly instructor office hours.
responsibilities: Complete 8 container orchestration lab exercises in the AITS Kubernetes cluster
Maintain 90% attendance across weekend live architecture deep dives
Sit for official certification exam by January 15, 2027
opportunities.eligibility: All 2nd, 3rd, and 4th year students with foundational Linux command-line literacy.

learningRoadmap.resourceName: Docker Mastery: From Containers to Swarm & Compose

opportunities.title: UI/UX Design Sprint: Campus Services Redesign
opportunities.location: Design Studio Lab, School of Liberal Arts & Humanities
opportunities.description: Collaborative 3-day product design sprint tackling actual student pain points: library book reservations, dining hall menus, and gym slots. Winning design system will be implemented directly into the official university portal.
responsibilities: Conduct user interviews with at least 15 fellow students and faculty members
Build clickable, accessible Figma prototypes adhering to WCAG AA guidelines
Document a complete tokenized design system component library
opportunities.eligibility: Open to students of all years and majors. Beginners with enthusiasm are welcomed.

learningRoadmap.resourceName: Refactoring UI: Practical UI Design Tactics

opportunities.title: Deep Learning for Medical Imaging Fellowship
opportunities.organizer: Bio-Informatics Research Cell & Narayana Health Collaboration
opportunities.location: Bio-AI Lab, Central Campus / Narayana Health City
opportunities.description: Develop transformer-based segmentation models for automated detection of early-stage diabetic retinopathy on multi-spectral retinal fundus scans in collaboration with clinical ophthalmologists.
responsibilities: Pre-process and augment clinical DICOM and TIFF retinal imagery
Train vision transformers (ViT) and validate sensitivity/specificity metrics
Prepare quarterly benchmark results for clinical audit boards
opportunities.eligibility: Pre-final or postgraduate students with proven PyTorch proficiency and strong linear algebra/statistics background.

learningRoadmap.resourceName: PyTorch for Deep Learning & Vision Transformers

opportunities.title: Product Management Fellowship: Campus EdTech
opportunities.location: Vice Chancellor Office Wing, Central Campus
opportunities.description: Work closely with academic leadership to define roadmaps, write technical PRDs, and measure student engagement for digital classroom tools, exam schedules, and attendance automation.
responsibilities: Author PRDs with user stories, acceptance criteria, and metric definitions
Run weekly sprint triage and feature roadmapping with student dev teams
Track monthly active student usage and synthesize feedback survey findings
opportunities.eligibility: BBA, MBA, or B.Tech 3rd/4th year students with demonstrated product thinking and analytical communication skills.

learningRoadmap.resourceName: Lenny's Product Management Playbook & PRD Templates

events.title: Sound Clash: National Battle of the Bands
events.description: High-voltage collegiate rock, fusion, and indie bands duel on the main concert stage with full sound engineering support. Judged on originality, stage presence, and technical mastery.
events.eligibility: All verified undergraduate and postgraduate collegiate music bands (3-7 members).
rulesOrGuidelines: Performance time slot: 15 minutes + 5 minutes sound check
Original compositions score 25% bonus points in the judging rubric
Standard 5-piece drum kit and amplifiers provided by festival sound crew

events.title: Midnight Hack-a-Sprint: 24h AI & Campus Infrastructure Build
events.description: An overnight hack sprint where 60 teams build production-grade web applications, autonomous agent workflows, or university IoT solutions within 24 intense hours.

events.eligibility: Open to all Alliance University students across any department and batch.
events.organizer: IEEE Student Branch & Google Developer Student Club
rulesOrGuidelines: Teams of 2 to 4 members. Cross-department teams encouraged.
All code commits must be pushed to a fresh GitHub repo during the sprint window.
Food, Red Bull, caffeine bar, and rest pods provided throughout the night.

events.description: Large-group Western, Indo-contemporary, and hip-hop dance teams showcase synchronization, thematic storytelling, and athletic choreography.
events.eligibility: Student dance troupes of 8 to 25 members.
